title: RangeFilterRequest
description: RangeFilterRequest: Request for filtering database records based on value ranges for numeric and DateTime columns.

ColumnRanges.description:
Column range filters where each column has minimum and maximum values defined by GeneralDomain objects. 
Key is the column name, value is a GeneralDomain with Min and Max values. 
Supports numeric types (int, double, decimal) and DateTime. 
Example: {'Price': new GeneralDomain(100.0, 500.0), 'DateCreated': new GeneralDomain(DateTime(2023,1,1), DateTime(2023,12,31))}

TableName.description: Target table name for the filter operation. If not specified, will be derived from the request context.

InclusiveBounds.description:
Whether range bounds are inclusive (default) or exclusive. 
If true: Min <= value <= Max. If false: Min < value < Max.

Logic.description: Logical operator to combine multiple column filters. Default is AND. LogicalOperator: Defines logical operators for combining multiple filter conditions in SQL queries.

MaxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. If 0, returns all matching records.

SortColumns.description: List of columns to sort the results by. Applied in order of list sequence.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
